<formato>The output should be formatted as a JSON instance that conforms to the JSON schema below.

As an example, for the schema {"properties": {"foo": {"title": "Foo", "description": "a list of strings", "type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}}}, "required": ["foo"]}
the object {"foo": ["bar", "baz"]} is a well-formatted instance of the schema. The object {"properties": {"foo": ["bar", "baz"]}} is not well-formatted.

Here is the output schema:
```
{"additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"municipio": {"anyOf": [{"type": "string"}, {"type": "null"}], "title": "Municipio"}, "residuo": {"anyOf": [{"type": "string"}, {"type": "null"}], "title": "Residuo"}, "volume_m3": {"anyOf": [{"minimum": 0, "type": "number"}, {"type": "null"}], "title": "Volume M3"}, "codigo": {"anyOf": [{"type": "string"}, {"type": "null"}], "title": "Codigo"}}, "required": ["municipio", "residuo", "volume_m3", "codigo"]}
```</formato>
Qual é o município, o resíduo, o volume em m³ e o código do REGISTRO ALVO?
